song: 66 - The Pussycat Dolls - Buttons (Official Music Video) ft. Snoop Dogg
title: the lamp-lit room hits on the kick and cuts every two bars
story: Buttons at 107.5 BPM, a hip-hop backbeat: kick on 1, 3 and the 'a' of 4 (dark onsets, centroid < 0.17), snare/clap on 2 and 4 (bright, centroid > 0.21), sagging into a hats-only dropout at 2077-2110. The grid room is lit by its one lamp in blackout-red (black, ash, red, bone): every kick shakes the room and lifts the palette, every snare throws the sweep across the room and flattens the lamp, and the prominent hits (the double hit 2058/2069, the 10.33 pickup at 2114, the 15.8 slam at 2642) do both with a flash. The camera creeps from the back wall as in the original, then from the switch at 2148 it cuts every two bars on the downbeat (2148, 2287, 2430, 2573) to a new low or high angle with the weave and sweep switching and the palette's hue and contrast turning.
